description: Implementation of CategoryService for managing categories in an e-commerce system, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and hierarchy management.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing category management operations, including creation, retrieval, hierarchy management, and deletion.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new category, setting lineage and depth based on parent.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with given categories within a store.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their codes.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their IDs.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Gets a category in a specific language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a category.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories by lineage string.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories by SEO URL.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category by SEO URL.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by ID.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists subcategories of a given category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories by store and parent category.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories by parent and language.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category and associated products, managing hierarchy and product categories.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a category in a specific language.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category to a parent, updating lineage and depth.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories by depth within a store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by name within a store.
